name: Vashil
desc: Vashil tall and straight in chalk-pale robes, a halo of seven small glass bells on a chalk ring above his visor and a long striking rod in hand.

name: Chalkline Bells
desc: An ink-grey robe with chalk line-work drawn on it, in the style of the Aubade chalk drawings. The bells stay clear glass.

name: First Bell Halo
desc: Ten bells instead of seven, one for each hour-mark of the Shadowless Noon, over a pale dial-stone robe and a dark hem.
